method_archive.note: This branch keeps only the RCUT runs of the compare_plan2 archive (threshold 1 % and the 0.5 % / 2 % sensitivity runs, Case33 2D and 3D, 300 s, workers 16); the R, H, RB and RCUT2 runs and the cross-method reports are in tag results-methods-v1. metrics.json is authoritative and is not recomputed from this archive. RCUT inner sets are not certified (inner_exact false): its validity checks the outer bound only.
